assets.name: roaming_rebels_roster
assets.prompt: Generate a production character concept roster for BULLETS OF FURY titled exactly THE ROAMING REBELS. Reference 1 is inspiration for militia/hacker gear ONLY: replace that seven-character roster and its ideology. Reference 2 is the definitive face rendering and pixel-art style. Exactly FIVE distinct adults total: THREE MEN and TWO WOMEN, vicious deadly male leader INCLUDED in five. Grounded rugged western 16-bit arcade military pixel art, realistic adult faces, crisp pixels, not anime or manga, no smooth 3D. A hacker/militia faction opposing ALL organizations including Fury HQ; no Fury allegiance or heroic freedom propaganda. Design five non-overlapping full-body characters arranged across a wide dark hangar poster with portraits in five separate cards below. Left-to-right working names and roles: DARIUS VOSS / LEADER: 45yo male, hard scarred face, dark sidepart hair with gray temples, short beard, cold ruthless expression, blue-black flight coat, crimson scarf, hacked command gauntlet. NYX CALDER / INFILTRATOR: 35yo woman, dark undercut tied hair, severe adult face, violet/gray patched flight armor, intrusion wrist terminal. ROOK MERCER / ENFORCER: 45yo burly bald male, black stubble, broken nose, rust-orange ballistic plates and black flight pants. KAIA VANE / SIGNAL HACKER: 32yo woman, practical short sandy-blond hair, freckles, teal patched flight suit and utility rig, compact hacking tablet. JACE RIVEN / INTERCEPTOR: 30yo male, dark brown tousled hair, visible stubble, asymmetrical dark red flight jacket and black armor, angry focused expression. Distinct credible pilots, worn stolen military equipment, handpainted crossed-out faction badges and same simple broken-chevron rebel emblem. Each outfit practical and fully clothed. No rifles pointing toward camera. Bottom cards same square riveted frames as reference 2, colors respectively crimson, purple, orange, teal, red. Only text: title, names, roles, and small subtitle HACKER / MILITIA - NO ALLEGIANCE. Five people only, no extra background people. Faces in bottom cards repeat the corresponding five people. Premium readable composition, same degree of pixel detail as provided current pilot portraits.
